lines:
classDiagram
direction LR
class DesktopCommandEventAPI {
  <<boundary>>
  +submit(UiCommandV1) CommandReceiptV1
  +query(ProjectionQueryV1) ProjectionSnapshotV1
}
class ProjectConfigurationPort {
  <<service>>
  +resolveWorkspace(ProjectScopeV1) WorkspaceBindingV1
  +loadDocuments(FreezeRequestV1) DocumentSetV1
  +compareAndSwap(DocumentWriteV1) DocumentVersionV1
}
class SnapshotFreezer {
  <<compiler>>
  +validate(WorkflowDocumentV1) ValidationReportV1
  +freeze(FreezeInputsV1) FrozenRunSnapshotV1
}
class ChatRunLifecycle {
  <<aggregate service>>
  +handle(ChatCommandV1) CommitReceiptV1
  +applyWorkerProposal(WorkerProposalV1) CommitReceiptV1
}
class AuthorityDecisionPort {
  <<policy>>
  +evaluate(InvocationProposalV1) AuthorityDecisionV1
  +resolveApproval(ApprovalResponseV1) AuthorityDecisionV1
}
class InvocationBroker {
  <<broker>>
  +propose(InvocationProposalV1) InvocationStatusV1
  +settle(CapabilityOutcomeV1) CapabilityOutcomeV1
}
class SecretLeasePort {
  <<security>>
  +issue(LeaseRequestV1) SecretLeaseHandleV1
  +revoke(InvocationId) void
}
class CanonicalCommitPort {
  <<journal>>
  +commit(CommitRequestV1) CommitReceiptV1
  +pendingOutbox() OutboxRecordV1
}
class ProcessSupervisorPort {
  <<platform>>
  +spawn(ProcessSpecV1) ProcessGenerationV1
  +terminateTree(ProcessGenerationV1) void
}
class RecoveryCoordinator {
  <<recovery>>
  +recover(ChatId) RecoveryResultV1
}
class ExtensionRegistry {
  <<registry>>
  +pin(RequirementSetV1) ExtensionPinSetV1
  +attest(ProcessGenerationV1) AttestationV1
}
class RepairOrchestrator {
  <<state machine>>
  +activate(ActivateRepairV1) CommitReceiptV1
  +verify(VerificationV1) RepairOutcomeV1
}
class PortableRuntimeJournalPort {
  <<noncanonical local operations>>
  +begin(PortableRuntimeJournalEntryV1) PendingPortableCommitDurableV1
  +finalize(VerifiedPortableCommitV1) HeadLinkedDurableV1
  +pending(ChatId) PortableRuntimeJournalEntryV1
}
class RepairBootstrapPort {
  <<surviving trusted helper>>
  +handoff(RepairActivationBatonV1) BootstrapAdmissionV1
  +readResult(ActivationId) BootstrapResultV1
}
class FrozenRunSnapshotV1 {
  <<immutable Aworkit DTO>>
  +snapshotId
  +workflowHash
  +workspaceIdentity
  +historyMode
  +extensionPins
}
class AuthorityManifestV1 {
  <<immutable Aworkit DTO>>
  +manifestHash
  +capabilities
  +scopes
  +budgets
  +credentialRefs
}
class ApprovedInvocationEnvelopeV1 {
  <<Aworkit DTO>>
  +invocationId
  +decisionId
  +bindingHash
  +scope
  +deadline
  +leaseHandles
}
DesktopCommandEventAPI --> ProjectConfigurationPort : typed configuration intents
DesktopCommandEventAPI --> ChatRunLifecycle : typed lifecycle commands
DesktopCommandEventAPI --> InvocationBroker : approvals and cancellation
ChatRunLifecycle --> SnapshotFreezer : first-input freeze
SnapshotFreezer --> ProjectConfigurationPort : exact versioned inputs
SnapshotFreezer --> ExtensionRegistry : pinned identity and compatibility
SnapshotFreezer --> AuthorityDecisionPort : compile manifest and summary
SnapshotFreezer --> FrozenRunSnapshotV1 : creates
FrozenRunSnapshotV1 *-- AuthorityManifestV1 : contains
ChatRunLifecycle --> CanonicalCommitPort : lifecycle batch plus outbox
ChatRunLifecycle --> ProcessSupervisorPort : committed worker control
InvocationBroker --> AuthorityDecisionPort : permit deny or approval
InvocationBroker --> SecretLeasePort : approved invocation only
InvocationBroker --> CanonicalCommitPort : authorization outcome and outbox
InvocationBroker --> ApprovedInvocationEnvelopeV1 : creates
RecoveryCoordinator --> CanonicalCommitPort : stream checkpoint and outbox
RecoveryCoordinator --> ProcessSupervisorPort : generation-fenced restart
RecoveryCoordinator --> ChatRunLifecycle : rehydrate pure aggregate
RepairOrchestrator --> CanonicalCommitPort : candidate gate and baton
RepairOrchestrator --> ProcessSupervisorPort : restart or rollback
RepairOrchestrator --> RecoveryCoordinator : resume same Management Chat
CanonicalCommitPort --> PortableRuntimeJournalPort : portable pending and head-linked saga
RecoveryCoordinator --> PortableRuntimeJournalPort : reconcile by commit and head hashes
RepairOrchestrator --> RepairBootstrapPort : durable approved activation handoff
